'''Matt Potter''' is the 1998 SWCCG World Champion (United States), the first American winner. He defeated [[Michael Riboulet]] 2 (+9) in the Operatives final at the Cavalier Hotel.

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub. Facts below are from published SWCCG tournament sources. It does not add unsourced biography.
